{{Top|leg}}
'''Qexi's''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the town of [[Great Rock]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] recruiter [[Renci Tosh]] once attempted to enlist the help of a group a [[spacer]]s there soon after crash landing her [[Z-95 Headhunter]] in the wilderness outside the town.<ref name="CG1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020530a|text=Rendezvous at Ord Mantell|int=Rendezvous at Ord Mantell}}</ref>
